name: html-font-toolbar
description: Obsidian plugin: floating formatting toolbar that styles selected text as one clean inline HTML span - color, highlight, size, font, B/I/U/S, table-aware alignment

paragraphs: An Obsidian plugin that gives you a floating, Word-like formatting toolbar — but with a twist that makes it different from every other formatting plugin: everything it produces is one clean inline HTML span.

Markdown formatting (bold, ==highlight==) and HTML styling () don't nest predictably. Mix plugins that use different syntaxes and you get conflicts: a highlight that locks the font color, bold that can't be colored, nested tags that break each other.
HTML Font Toolbar avoids the whole problem by staying in one layer:
features: Select a word → click red → click yellow highlight → click Large → click B

One span. Never nested wrappers. Click again to change or toggle any property — the plugin finds the existing span (even when Live Preview hides the markup) and edits it in place. It even repairs pre-existing nested…
Text color — 6 theme-safe presets + a persistent custom color slot with picker; click the same color again to remove it
Highlight — 6 semi-transparent presets that work in light and dark themes + custom slot; click the same highlight again to remove it
Bold / Italic / Underline / Strikethrough — as span styles, so they merge and toggle
